title: ScrapeRun
description: Field list per spec.md metadata schema section, 'Scrape Run'. Not itself catalog content (not one of the common-fields entities - no id/first_seen_at/last_scraped_at/is_deleted) but required to support freshness/failure display. Same ingest rule as every other entity applies: tenant_id is server-resolved from the API key and must never appear in a push payload; data_plane_id is supplied once at the envelope level, not repeated here.

tenant_id.description: Server-assigned. Never accepted from a push payload - present here only to document the stored shape.
